title: PD co-pathology signal estimation: raw participant feature record, schema version 1.0
description: One participant's baseline features before any pipeline step. Absent or null features are handled only by the frozen pipeline. Unknown fields are ignored and counted (n_unrecognised_fields). A supplied value that is not a number is a validation error.
x-contract-source: The v1 inference input contract reflects the raw pre-pipeline feature union of the frozen final model bundle. It is intentionally not identical to the broader modelling-tier candidate feature configuration.

participant_id.description: Caller's (pseudonymous) identifier; echoed in the output; not a model feature.

cohort.description: Optional enrolment cohort. Used only for cohort_in_training_scope; never a model feature.
